title: ConnectController reaches up into its parent main, breaking the codebase's signal-wiring pattern
detail: The controller duck-types its parent (Node3D) and reads main.sim directly, inverting composition direction. Every sibling module (router, qos_panel, rig) communicates via signals wired in main._ready; this module alone calls up, making it untestable without the full scene.
recommended_fix: Emit a connect_requested(a, b) signal from the controller (plus a sim-provider or pipe-count signal) and wire it to main.request_connect alongside the router signals in _ready.

title: pulse_egress maps sim node ids to scene child order via an implicit invariant instead of the explicit node_index
detail: The sim-index == child-order equivalence is implicit and unasserted. NodeSite already carries node_index ('var node_index := -1 # sim node id (staging order = WorldSeed order)'). Any future removal/reorder (E3 demolish, density changes) silently pulses the wrong building with no error.
recommended_fix: Build an index-to-NodeSite map in FlowView.setup() keyed by site.node_index and resolve pulse targets through it.

title: One-shot editor capture harness code embedded in the runtime composition root
detail: ~50 lines of capture-harness responsibility (viewport camera repositioning, force_draw, PNG save, quit) live in the game's composition root, while all other harness code lives in tools/ and capture_runner.gd. Future capture affordances will grow main.gd.
recommended_fix: Move the viewport-capture body into tools/ (like determinism_log.gd); main keeps only the Regenerate Preview inspector button and delegates to it.
